integrity_statement: This mathematical analysis is a proof with supplementary finite numerical tests; no outside referee, independent audit, or historical priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed n≥3, smooth positively curved planar bodies, iid tangent sampling. First-order conditional tail; higher dimensions, non-smooth curves, random offsets, and statistical stability are unproved.
title: Curvature–width Pareto law for bounded random tangent polygons
